Pricodex

PRINCESS CONNECT! Re:Dive · JPPricodex

Every playable character from the Japanese server's master data, pulled 6 November 2026: kits with skill types, roles, elements and unique equipment.

How to read this
  • Position comes from the attack range: Front under 300, Middle 300 to 599, Back 600 and over. Lower range stands further forward.
  • Element and role are the game's own tags. The portrait is the character's highest-star icon from the game, framed in its element's colour.
  • Skills: “Union Burst ★6” is the 6★ Union Burst. “+” and “++” are the upgraded versions. SP skills belong to a special mode or form. The EX skill is the passive.
  • Skill types: the grey label on a skill is the game's own category for it (its icon). The outlined tags come from the skill's actual effects in the data, so one skill can carry several, and conditional effects count too. A character's “Effects” line and the Skill effects filter cover every version of its skills. Buff and Heal include effects on the character itself, so nearly everyone has Buff: they are shown but not offered as filters (the Role filter finds team buffers and healers). Ally TP leaves out TP a character gives only itself. Taunt, dispel and summons are not tagged.
  • GameWith: the tier and the score out of 10 are GameWith's own overall ratings (gamewith.jp), copied by hand on . They are their editorial opinion, not game data, and they move with the meta; their pages show no update date. Tier 0 is the best, Tier 4 the lowest priority, which they say does not mean weak. The score is the one given before ★6; characters with ★6 have a second score, and a “?” marks a provisional one. The GW score filter and sort use the ★6 score when there is one.
  • English text: names and descriptions come from the closed EN server when the skill is unchanged since then. Everything newer is a fan translation made for this codex, marked fan TL. Turn on Japanese text to compare with what you see in game.
  • Your roster: press “I own this” on a character, then use the Show filter to list owned or missing ones. The list is saved in this browser only, so each person who opens the link keeps their own. “Collection tools” has a backup code to move it to another device.

Data: JP master database mirrored by Expugn/priconne-database. Character icons are taken from the game, © Cygames. Tiers and scores: GameWith. Fan-made reference, not affiliated with Cygames.
